content: What information do open-text student reviews provide beyond numerical ratings, and can text analysis identify actionable feedback that ratings alone cannot capture?
Binary sentiment Y: 1 for ratings {4,5}, 0 for ratings {1,2}; rating 3 excluded as neutral/ambiguous.
Final LR test performance: Accuracy=0.9268, F1=0.9280 (README-reported).
Binary coding improves interpretability/actionability and reduces midpoint ambiguity; tradeoff is reduced granularity.
4-class NB sensitivity: weighted F1=0.6717 vs binary weighted F1=0.9210; substantive positive/negative language dimensions remain directionally consistent.
Negation-aware LR improved test F1 from 0.9482 to 0.9577 and reduced negation-tagged errors by 17.71%.
